title: Section 64 — Private alienation after attachment void — CPC 1908

content.heading: Private alienation of property after attachment to be void
content.text: Where an attachment has been made, any private transfer or delivery of the property attached or of any interest therein and any payment to the judgment-debtor of any debt, dividend or other moneys contrary to such attachment, shall be void as against all claims enforceable under the attachment. Nothing in this section applies to any private transfer or delivery of the property made in pursuance of any contract for such transfer or delivery entered into and registered before the attachment.
